_doc: M4-A2P-075 (Ch13, cinematics'): the Lamp Archive's cutscene shots, marks and lamp, from act2_ch13_direction.md. Three frames moved onto the dressing's tables: R04 (Corran's margin) looks down onto the roll table's page, R08's pull-out ends over the ledger table's eight pages (the notes' frame looked past the table), and R10 is Sefir at the reading table (the notes' frame looked at the empty floor between the tables), lit by archive_lamp, the lamp @light puts out. R06 frames Ysolde's hands and Liss from her right.
